description: Source code for GatewayServiceResolver, a Swift class implementing a Bonjour service resolver based on NetService, for resolving service endpoints without trusting TXT records.

classes.name: GatewayServiceResolver
classes.description: A final class that performs Bonjour service resolution using NetService, providing endpoint hostname and port via a callback.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializer that sets up the NetService instance with specified name, type, and domain, and assigns the delegate.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins the service resolution with an optional timeout.

methods.name: netServiceDidResolveAddress
methods.description: Delegate method called when the service's address has been resolved; extracts hostname and port and finalizes resolution.

methods.name: netService
methods.description: Delegate method called when resolution fails; triggers completion with nil result.

methods.name: finish
methods.description: Handles finishing the resolution process, ensuring it's only done once, stopping and removing the service, then calling the completion callback.

methods.name: normalizeHost
methods.description: Static helper method to normalize the host name using external support.
